title: Neon Pulse — Episode 68: Countdown In The Sky
description: Kael confronts the live countdown timer on the abandoned orbital platform while deadly automated security turrets power up.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The countdown display pulses with an unforgiving red glow. Only minutes remain before the metropolis below faces total destruction.
scenes.visual: close up shot of a digital glowing red countdown timer on a futuristic metal console with sparks flying and dark metallic interior background

scenes.narration: Heavy robotic shutters grind open along the ceiling. Rows of automated defense turrets lock their target sensors straight onto my position.
scenes.visual: low angle shot looking up as multiple heavy automated gun turrets emerge from ceiling slots and point laser sights downward

scenes.narration: A barrage of plasma fire tears through the air. I throw myself behind a heavy steel control console just as it shatters into glowing debris.
scenes.visual: dynamic action shot of the character diving sideways through the air while glowing plasma blasts impact metal panels sending sparks in all directions

scenes.narration: The amber circuitry on my sleeves flares brightly. I channel the surging energy directly into the platform's central power conduit.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the character kneeling with hands pressed against a massive sparking terminal while glowing amber light streams from arms

scenes.narration: A massive surge of feedback ripples through the network. The turrets momentarily stall, their targeting lasers flickering out of sync.
scenes.visual: wide shot of robotic turrets sparking and malfunctioning on a dark metallic platform with dramatic overhead lighting casting deep shadows

scenes.narration: Before the security system can reboot, a hidden holographic projector flickers to life above the console. Commander Vance's cold smile fills the room.
scenes.visual: medium close up of the character staring up in shock at a glowing blue translucent holographic projection of a stern military commander

scenes.narration: He reveals the countdown cannot be stopped from the inside. The entire orbital platform is locked on a one-way collision course.
scenes.visual: over the shoulder shot looking at a giant observation window showing a sprawling metropolis far below under a dark night sky

scenes.narration: With the escape shuttle bay already sealing shut, I need to find another way off this station before time runs out completely.
scenes.visual: wide shot of the character standing alone on a high metal catwalk looking toward a closing heavy blast door at the end of the corridor

scenes.narration: Follow along for the next chapter as the battle for the metropolis reaches its most desperate hour.
scenes.visual: dramatic cinematic portrait of the character turning around with a determined expression against a backdrop of distant glowing stars
